name: Francisco Assis - § 60 - Am 7
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 60. Calls for the protection of civilians at all times in situations of armed conflict and for humanitarian corridors to be established in neighbouring countries, when necessary, to allow civilians to escape conflicts, in accordance with international humanitarian law and relevant UN guidelines, and to ensure that such mechanisms do not result in abuses and mass inflows of refugees into the European Union, which could encourage further massive waves of migration; strongly condemns any attacks on civilians;
